channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Japan Beer Companies Raided Over Alleged Price-Fixing Cartel
item.description: Japan's Fair Trade Commission conducted searches of the country's largest beer-makers, including Asahi and Kirin, over allegations of a price-fixing cartel. Reports suggest that leaders of these beer companies may have been aware of the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Met Police Volunteer Force Chief Sacked Over Sexual Images
item.description: The head of the Metropolitan Police's volunteer force has been sacked after artificial intelligence identified that he captured sexual images on a work phone. The specific details of the images or the exact date of the discovery were not… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Driver Jailed for 10 Years After Killing Student While High on Laughing Gas
item.description: A 27-year-old driver has been sentenced to 10 years in prison for killing a music student in an incident in east London. The driver was speeding and under the influence of nitrous oxide, commonly known as laughing gas, at the time of the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Police Investigate Unexplained Infant Death at Adelaide Motel
item.description: South Australian Police are investigating the unexplained death of an infant at the Tollgate Motel in Adelaide. A crime scene has been established at the location. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Two Men Survive Light Aircraft Crash in Field
item.description: Two men have survived a light aircraft crash in a field near Fergus, Ontario. Police are investigating the incident. Both individuals were described as 'very lucky' to have survived. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Man Jailed for Life for Murdering Wife and Hiding Body
item.description: A man has been sentenced to life imprisonment for murdering his wife and concealing her body in a freezer. While hiding her remains, he reportedly contacted escorts. The details of the crime and sentencing were reported by UK-based outlets. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Ambassador Kimberly Guilfoyle Investigated Over $100,000 Demand
item.description: U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle and the embassy she leads are under investigation by the State Department's Office of the Inspector General. The probe is reportedly related to allegations that Guilfoyle demanded a donor pay a… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Prediction Markets Face Scrutiny Over Game Integrity and Swap Definitions
item.description: The National Football League (NFL) has warned the Supreme Court that prediction markets pose a threat to the integrity of games. Concurrently, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) has proposed expanding the definition of swaps… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: 21-year-old woman found dead in Melbourne apartment
item.description: A 21-year-old woman, identified as Jayda Allen Bonner, was found dead in an apartment in Carlton, Melbourne. Her aunt stated that the family had feared for her safety and that she was 'captured' before her death. The circumstances… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: ICE Shooting Sparks Political Clash Over Sanctuary City Policies
item.description: Following a shooting involving an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officer in New York City, a political clash has erupted over sanctuary city policies. Representative Markwayne Mullin criticized these policies in the aftermath of… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Russian Pro-War Blogger Detained and Expelled from Montenegro
item.description: A prominent Russian pro-war blogger was detained in Montenegro and subsequently ordered to leave the country. The blogger, identified in some reports as popular and wanted by the US, was among five individuals arrested. The specific… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: French Police Tactics Scrutinized Amid Student Protests
item.description: French police tactics are facing scrutiny following injuries sustained by students during nationwide protests. Reports indicate at least one teenager suffered a broken jaw, drawing criticism of police conduct. The protests themselves are… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Court Convicts Ex-AAP Councillor Tahir Hussain in 2020 Delhi Riots Case
item.description: A court has convicted former Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) Councillor Tahir Hussain for abetment of rioting in connection with the 2020 Northeast Delhi riots. The conviction relates to a case linked to the riots. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Toddler dies after allegedly ingesting gold-testing chemical in Hyderabad
item.description: A two-year-old girl has died in Hyderabad after allegedly consuming a chemical used for testing gold. The incident occurred in Hyderabad. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Parliamentary panel suggests NEET exam reforms amid paper leak concerns
item.description: A parliamentary panel has recommended significant reforms for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) exam, including the implementation of digital question banks and a shift towards computer-based testing (CBT). The panel also… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Army Defuses Five Landmines Along LoC in Poonch
item.description: The Army's Bomb Disposal Squad defused five landmines discovered along the Line of Control (LoC) in Jammu and Kashmir's Poonch district. The mines were destroyed through controlled explosions. Officials indicated that heavy rainfall could… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: SEBI revises settlement rules, introduces new formula and fast-track options
item.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has notified revised Settlement Regulations, 2026. These regulations introduce a new formula for calculating settlement amounts, separating disgorgement from settlement payments… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court Forms Committee for Judicial Well-Being
item.description: The Supreme Court has established a Standing Committee focused on Judicial Well-Being. Chief Justice Surya Kant constituted this committee, which is intended to address the mental health of judges. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: CJI Intervenes in Detention of Lawyers After Protest March
item.description: Chief Justice of India (CJI) intervention secured the release of lawyers detained following a protest march. The coverage notes that journalists covering the protests did not receive similar intervention for their release. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Delhi Police Detain Journalists, Overlook Press Cards
item.description: Delhi Police detained journalists, including four reporters from Newslaundry and reporters from Scroll, NBT and Reporter TV, and did not accept their press cards despite the police’s own guidelines on accreditation. Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Calcutta High Court: Peaceful Protest Not a Crime Due to Dislike by Authorities
item.description: The Calcutta High Court has ruled that peaceful protests cannot be considered criminal offenses simply because they are disliked by authorities. The court emphasized that the right to dissent and assemble peacefully is a fundamental aspect… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi High Court orders Amitabh Bachchan to appear in personality rights case
item.description: The Delhi High Court has ordered actor Amitabh Bachchan to appear in person for the next hearing of a personality rights suit, particularly if a settlement in the case remains incomplete. The court's directive was issued in response to a… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Two Delhi Police personnel injured during protest detentions
item.description: Two Delhi Police personnel, including a member of the Pink Force, were injured near the Kartavya Path and Akashwani Bhawan areas during the detention of protesters. The injuries occurred amidst stone pelting directed at police personnel. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Car Fires Reported Across India, Families Escape Blaze
item.description: Multiple incidents of cars catching fire while in motion have been reported across India. In Panipat, a family narrowly escaped a severe fire that engulfed their car as they were traveling to bathe in the Yamuna River; the fire reportedly… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi court dismisses defamation case against AAP leader Saurabh Bharadwaj
item.description: A Delhi court has dismissed a criminal defamation complaint filed by Parvesh Verma against Aam Aadmi Party leader Saurabh Bharadwaj. The court found that the questions posed by Bharadwaj were not defamatory. Verma, a Member of Parliament… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Kuki Woman Killed in Manipur, Sparking Gunfire and Restrictions
item.description: A Kuki woman was killed in Manipur's Kamjong district amid a drive to demolish illegal bunkers. The incident led to gunfire between Kuki and Naga groups, and subsequent arson. Prohibitory orders were imposed in the area, including near the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Sharjeel Imam's interim bail cancelled by Delhi court
item.description: A Delhi court has cancelled the interim bail granted to activist Sharjeel Imam. The Delhi Police had moved the court seeking cancellation, alleging that Imam had breached the conditions of his bail, specifically a media gag order. The case… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Supreme Court Faces Contempt Plea Over Delhi Metro Closures
item.description: A contempt petition has been filed in the Supreme Court alleging arbitrary metro station closures and train cancellations in Delhi, despite a court order. The plea specifically targets the Delhi Police chief. The closures and cancellations… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Indian national jailed in Paris for leading child abuse ring
item.description: Rohan Rane, an Indian national, has been sentenced to 20 years in prison by a Paris court for leading an online child abuse ring. The court found him guilty of offenses including extortion, torture, and barbarity against victims. The ring… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: MPSC Aspirants Protest in Pune, FIR Filed Against Representatives
item.description: A protest by Maharashtra Public Service Commission (MPSC) aspirants took place in Pune, with participants expressing feelings of betrayal by the state. Following the protest, Pune police filed a First Information Report (FIR) against 15… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Oil tanker attacked off Sharjah, 22 Indian crew safe
item.description: A Panama-flagged oil tanker, MT GEM NO. 2, was hit in a drone attack at Sharjah Anchorage on October 9. All 22 Indian crew members aboard the vessel were reported to be safe. Union Minister for Shipping Sarbananda Sonowal confirmed the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 3.

item.title: GST Council Overhauls Enforcement, Changes Tax Treatment
item.description: The Goods and Services Tax (GST) Council has decided to remove arrest powers for tax officers and raise the prosecution threshold to Rs 5 crore. Additionally, the council has endorsed a uniform tax treatment for operators, proposing a 5%… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 1.

item.title: Massive Wine Heist in Italy: 30,000 Bottles Stolen
item.description: Masked thieves carried out what is described as Italy's largest ever wine robbery last weekend at a warehouse in central Italy, stealing approximately 30,000 bottles. The stolen wine is valued at over $5.6 million, with some reports… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 7 · Right 1.

item.title: Kashmiri filmmaker detained by US immigration authorities
item.description: Kashmir-born filmmaker Arfat Sheikh has been detained by US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) for two weeks and is awaiting a bail hearing. The detention occurred in the US. Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Kerala High Court Upholds Woman's Right to Personal Dress Choice
item.description: The Kerala High Court has affirmed a woman's right to choose her attire, stating that dress is a personal choice. In a related but distinct ruling, the court also stated that hitting a woman's chest with an elbow does not, in itself… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Referee suspended after physical confrontation with high school player
item.description: A referee has been suspended following a physical confrontation with a high school football player. The incident occurred during a high school football game. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Punjab Govt Challenges HC-Ordered CBI Probe into ED Letter
item.description: The Punjab and Haryana High Court has ordered a CBI probe into a letter from the Enforcement Directorate (ED) concerning the Punjab Director General of Police. The High Court also reportedly reprimanded the Chief Secretary over a 'false'… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 8 · Right 2.

item.title: Assam Woman Found Dead in Andhra Pradesh After Train Complaint
item.description: An Assam woman was found dead near railway tracks in Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh. She had reportedly complained about drunk men aboard the train she was traveling on. The Andhra Pradesh police have formed a Special Investigation Team (SIT)… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Odisha Student Union Polls Cancelled Amid Violence, Allegations
item.description: Student union elections in Odisha have been cancelled following crude bomb blasts at a college, leading to its closure. The Biju Janata Dal (BJD) has alleged that the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) favored certain candidates, violating… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Four CRPF personnel injured in Chhattisgarh landmine blast
item.description: Four Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) personnel were injured in a landmine blast in Sukma, Chhattisgarh. Two of the injured personnel are reported to be in critical condition. The injured personnel have been moved to Hyderabad for… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.
